```{r}
#| label: libraries
#| include: false
#| cache: false

library(tidyverse)
library(tidybayes)
library(ggdist)
library(ordbetareg)
library(bayestestR)
library(patchwork)
library(distributional)
library(ggtext)

PALETTE <- c("#C0C0C0", "#E61C38")

set_theme(theme(plot.background=element_rect(fill="#fafafa", color=NA)))

theme_cc <- function(base_size=18, base_family="", ink="black", paper="#fafafa") {
  list(
    theme_classic(base_size=base_size, base_family=base_family,
                  ink=ink, paper=paper),
    theme(legend.background=element_blank(),
          strip.text=element_text(color=ink))
  )
}

theme_exp1 <- function(ylab, base_size=18, base_family="", ink="black", paper=NA) {
  c(theme_cc(), 
    list(
      scale_y_continuous(ylab, limits=0:1, labels=c("0", ".25", ".5", ".75", "1"),
                         expand=c(0, 0)),
      scale_linetype_manual("Variable", values=c("dotted", "solid"),
                            breaks=c("a", "c"), drop = FALSE,
                            labels=c("Alternate\nCause", "Focal\nCause")),
      scale_side_mirrored(start="bottomleft"),
      scale_fill_manual(name="Normality",
                        breaks=c("Normal", "Abnormal"),
                        labels=c('Normal\n(\u03C3=50)', 'Abnormal\n(\u03C3=1)'),
                        values=PALETTE, drop = FALSE),
      scale_color_manual(name="Normality",
                         breaks=c("Normal", "Abnormal"),
                         labels=c('Normal\n(\u03C3=50)', 'Abnormal\n(\u03C3=1)'),
                         values=PALETTE, drop = FALSE)
    ))
}

theme_exp2 <- function(ylab, base_size=18, base_family="", ink="black", paper=NA) {
  c(theme_cc(), 
    list(
      scale_y_continuous(ylab, limits=0:1, labels=c("0", ".25", ".5", ".75", "1"),
                         expand=c(0, 0)),
      scale_linetype_manual("Variable", values=c("dotted", "solid"),
                            breaks=c("a", "c"), drop = FALSE,
                            labels=c("Alternate\nCause", "Focal\nCause")),
      scale_side_mirrored(start="bottomleft"),
      scale_fill_manual(name="Normality",
                        breaks=c("Normal", "Abnormal"), drop=FALSE,
                        labels=c("Normal\n(\u03BC=75)", "Abnormal\n(\u03BC=25)"),
                        values=PALETTE),
      scale_color_manual(name="Normality",
                         breaks=c("Normal", "Abnormal"), drop=FALSE,
                         labels=c("Normal\n(\u03BC=75)", "Abnormal\n(\u03BC=25)"),
                         values=PALETTE)
    ))
}


## display a box over a plot for animations
hide_plot <- function(plot, fill='#fafafa') {
  plot + inset_element(plot_spacer() +
                         theme(plot.background=element_rect(fill=fill)),
                       0, 0, 1, 1, align_to='full')
}
```


```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
######################################################################
##                           Experiment 1 data
######################################################################
d.exp1 <- read_csv("../analyses/data/experiment1_judgments.csv") |> 
  filter(attention_check == "Yes.") |>
  mutate(normality=factor(sd_c, levels=c(50, 1), labels=c("Normal", "Abnormal")),
         structure=factor(threshold, levels=c(199, 99),
                          labels=c("Conjunctive", "Disjunctive"))) |>
  select(-sd_c) |>
  group_by(structure, normality)

## Read in the learning stage data
d.exp1.learning <- read_csv("../analyses/data/experiment1_learning.csv") |>
  filter(id %in% d.exp1$id) |>
  mutate(normality=factor(sd_c, levels=c(50, 1), labels=c("Normal", "Abnormal")),
         structure=factor(threshold, levels=c(199, 99),
                          labels=c("Conjunctive", "Disjunctive")),
         block=factor(block),
         trial=factor(trial)) |>
  select(-sd_c) |>
  group_by(id, structure, normality, block)

## Estimate perceived variability by condition (manipulation check)
d.exp1.learning.check <- d.exp1.learning |>
  group_by(vignette, .add=TRUE) |>
  summarize(c=manipulation_check_c[1],
            a=manipulation_check_a[1]) |>
  pivot_longer(c:a, names_to="variable", values_to="perceived_variability") |>
  ungroup()
d.exp1.norm <- d.exp1 |>
  pivot_longer(vibes_c:vibes_a, names_prefix="vibes_",
               names_to="variable", values_to="perceived_normality")


m.exp1.learning <- readRDS("../analyses/models/experiment1/learning.rds")
m.exp1.norm <- readRDS("../analyses/models/experiment1/normality.rds")
m.exp1.cause <- readRDS("../analyses/models/experiment1/cause.rds")
m.exp1.confidence <- readRDS("../analyses/models/experiment1/confidence.rds")

######################################################################
##                           Experiment 2 data
######################################################################
## Read in the judgment data
d.exp2 <- read_csv("../analyses/data/experiment2_judgments.csv") |> 
  filter(attention_check == "Yes.") |>
  mutate(normality=factor(mu_c, levels=c(75, 25), labels=c("Normal", "Abnormal")),
         structure=factor(threshold, levels=c(167,83), labels=c("Conjunctive", "Disjunctive"))) |>
  select(-mu_c) |>
  group_by(structure, normality)


## Read in the learning stage data
d.exp2.learning <- read_csv("../analyses/data/experiment2_learning.csv") |>
  filter(id %in% d.exp2$id) |>
  mutate(normality=factor(mu_c, levels=c(75, 25), labels=c("Normal", "Abnormal")),
         structure=factor(threshold, levels=c(167, 83), labels=c("Conjunctive", "Disjunctive")),
         block=factor(block),
         trial=factor(trial)) |>
  select(-mu_c) |>
  group_by(id, structure, normality, block)


## Estimate perceived average by condition (manipulation check)
d.exp2.learning.check <- d.exp2.learning |>
  group_by(vignette, .add=TRUE) |>
  summarize(c=manipulation_check_c[1],
            a=manipulation_check_a[1]) |>
  pivot_longer(c:a, names_to="variable", values_to="perceived_average") |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(variable=factor(variable, levels=c("c","a")))

d.exp2.norm <- d.exp2 |>
  pivot_longer(vibes_c:vibes_a, names_prefix="vibes_",
               names_to="variable", values_to="perceived_normality")

m.exp2.learning <- readRDS("../analyses/models/experiment2/learning.rds")
m.exp2.norm <- readRDS("../analyses/models/experiment2/normality.rds")
m.exp2.cause <- readRDS("../analyses/models/experiment2/cause.rds")
m.exp2.confidence <- readRDS("../analyses/models/experiment2/confidence.rds")
```

## A formal description

:::{.r-stack height=600}
::::{.fragment .center-flex}
```{.tikz width=1000}
%%| filename: binary_causal_structure_1
%%| additionalPackages: \usepackage{amsmath}
\include{tikz_header.tex}
\begin{tikzpicture}[-Latex]
	\node[state, hidden] (E) {$E$};
    \node[state] (C) [above left = of E] {$C$};
    \node[state, hidden] (A) [below left = of E] {$A$};
    \path[hidden] (C) edge (E);
    \path[hidden] (A) edge (E);
    \node[unboxed, minimum size=0cm, hidden] (eqnA) [right = 1cm of E] {$A \sim \bernoulli{p_A}$};
    \node[unboxed, minimum size=0cm] (eqnC) [above = .5mm of eqnA] {$C \sim \bernoulli{p_C}$};
    \node[unboxed, minimum size=0cm, hidden] (eqnE) [below = .5mm of eqnA] {$E = \; C \wedge A$};
\end{tikzpicture}
```
::::

::::{.fragment .center-flex}
```{.tikz width=1000}
%%| filename: binary_causal_structure_2
%%| additionalPackages: \usepackage{amsmath}
\include{tikz_header.tex}
\begin{tikzpicture}[-Latex]
	\node[state, hidden] (E) {$E$};
    \node[state] (C) [above left = of E] {$C$};
    \node[state] (A) [below left = of E] {$A$};
    \path[hidden] (C) edge (E);
    \path[hidden] (A) edge (E);
    \node[unboxed, minimum size=0cm] (eqnA) [right = 1cm of E] {$A \sim \bernoulli{p_A}$};
    \node[unboxed, minimum size=0cm] (eqnC) [above = .5mm of eqnA] {$C \sim \bernoulli{p_C}$};
    \node[unboxed, minimum size=0cm, hidden] (eqnE) [below = .5mm of eqnA] {$E = \; C \wedge A$};
\end{tikzpicture}
```
::::

::::{.fragment .center-flex}
```{.tikz width=1000}
%%| filename: binary_causal_structure_3
%%| additionalPackages: \usepackage{amsmath}
\include{tikz_header.tex}
\begin{tikzpicture}[-Latex]
	\node[state] (E) {$E$};
    \node[state] (C) [above left = of E] {$C$};
    \node[state] (A) [below left = of E] {$A$};
    \path (C) edge (E);
    \path (A) edge (E);
    \node[unboxed, minimum size=0cm] (eqnA) [right = 1cm of E] {$A \sim \bernoulli{p_A}$};
    \node[unboxed, minimum size=0cm] (eqnC) [above = .5mm of eqnA] {$C \sim \bernoulli{p_C}$};
    \node[unboxed, minimum size=0cm] (eqnE) [below = .5mm of eqnA] {$E = \; C \wedge A$};
\end{tikzpicture}
```
::::
:::


:::{.much-smaller .absolute bottom=25 right=150}
[$C=1$, $A=1$.]{.fragment}

[So, $E = 1$.]{.fragment}

[To what extent did $C=1$ cause $E=1$?]{.fragment}
:::


## Two causal structures

:::{.columns}
::::{.column width="40%" .box .fragment}
**Conjunctive**

[$E = \; C \wedge A$]{.much-smaller}

:::::{.tiny .fragment}
 * $C=1$ and $A=1$ are both necessary
 * Neither $C=1$ nor $A=1$ is sufficient
:::::
::::

::::{.column width="10%"}
::::

::::{.column width="40%" .box .fragment}
**Disjunctive**

[$E = \; C \vee A$]{.much-smaller}

:::::{.tiny}


 * Neither $C=1$ nor $A=1$ are necessary
 * Either $C=1$ or $A=1$ is sufficient
:::::
::::
:::

![](https://ars.els-cdn.com/content/image/1-s2.0-S0010027717300100-gr2_lrg.jpg){.absolute bottom=0 right=275 width=500 style="border: 2px solid black;" .fragment}

:::{.bottom-left .tiny}
@icard2017normality
:::

## A formal description

:::{.r-stack height=600}
::::{.fragment .center-flex}
```{.tikz width=1000}
%%| filename: causal_structure_1
%%| additionalPackages: \usepackage{amsmath}
\include{tikz_header.tex}
\begin{tikzpicture}[-Latex]
	\node[state, hidden] (E) {$E$};
    \node[state] (C) [above left = of E] {$C$};
    \node[state, hidden] (A) [below left = of E] {$A$};
    \path[hidden] (C) edge (E);
    \path[hidden] (A) edge (E);
    \node[unboxed, minimum size=0cm, hidden] (eqnA) [right = 1cm of E] {$A \sim \normal{\mu_A}{\sigma_A}$};
    \node[unboxed, minimum size=0cm] (eqnC) [above = .5mm of eqnA] {$C \sim \normal{\mu_C}{\sigma_C}$};
    \node[unboxed, minimum size=0cm, hidden] (eqnE) [below = .5mm of eqnA] {$E = \; C + A > \theta$};
\end{tikzpicture}
```
::::

::::{.fragment .center-flex}
```{.tikz width=1000}
%%| filename: causal_structure_2
%%| additionalPackages: \usepackage{amsmath}
\include{tikz_header.tex}
\begin{tikzpicture}[-Latex]
	\node[state, hidden] (E) {$E$};
    \node[state] (C) [above left = of E] {$C$};
    \node[state] (A) [below left = of E] {$A$};
    \path[hidden] (C) edge (E);
    \path[hidden] (A) edge (E);
    \node[unboxed, minimum size=0cm] (eqnA) [right = 1cm of E] {$A \sim \normal{\mu_A}{\sigma_A}$};
    \node[unboxed, minimum size=0cm] (eqnC) [above = .5mm of eqnA] {$C \sim \normal{\mu_C}{\sigma_C}$};
    \node[unboxed, minimum size=0cm, hidden] (eqnE) [below = .5mm of eqnA] {$E = \; C + A > \theta$};
\end{tikzpicture}
```
::::

::::{.fragment .center-flex}
```{.tikz width=1000}
%%| filename: causal_structure_3
%%| additionalPackages: \usepackage{amsmath}
\include{tikz_header.tex}
\begin{tikzpicture}[-Latex]
	\node[state] (E) {$E$};
    \node[state] (C) [above left = of E] {$C$};
    \node[state] (A) [below left = of E] {$A$};
    \path (C) edge (E);
    \path (A) edge (E);
    \node[unboxed, minimum size=0cm] (eqnA) [right = 1cm of E] {$A \sim \normal{\mu_A}{\sigma_A}$};
    \node[unboxed, minimum size=0cm] (eqnC) [above = .5mm of eqnA] {$C \sim \normal{\mu_C}{\sigma_C}$};
    \node[unboxed, minimum size=0cm] (eqnE) [below = .5mm of eqnA] {$E = \; C + A > \theta$};
\end{tikzpicture}
```
::::
:::


:::{.much-smaller .absolute bottom=25 right=150}
[$C=c \;=\; A=a$.]{.fragment}

[$c+a > \theta$, so $E = 1$.]{.fragment}

[To what extent did $C=c$ cause $E=1$?]{.fragment}
:::


## Two special cases

:::{.columns}
::::{.column width="40%" .box .fragment}
**Conjunctive**

[$c+a=\theta+1$]{.much-smaller}

:::::{.tiny .fragment}
 * $C\ge c$ and $A\ge a$ are both necessary
 * Neither $C=c$ nor $A=c$ is sufficient
:::::
::::

::::{.column width="10%"}
::::

::::{.column width="40%" .box .fragment}
**Disjunctive**

[$c=a=\theta+1$]{.much-smaller}

:::::{.tiny}
 * Neither $C\ge c$ nor $A\ge a$ are necessary
 * Either $C=c$ or $A=a$ is sufficient
:::::
::::
:::

# Experiment 1 {.dark}

## Manipulations
:::{.r-stack .r-stretch}
::::{.fragment}
```{r}
#| label: exp1-manipulation-1
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6
d.exp1.manipulation <- tibble(name=c("Abnormal","Normal"),
                              mean=75, sd=c(1, 50),
                              actual=floor(4/3*mean + 2/3),
                              sum_mean=150, sum_sd=c(sqrt(1^2 + 50^2), sqrt(2*50^2))) |>
  mutate(name=factor(name, levels=c("Normal", "Abnormal")))

p.exp1.manipulation1 <- ggplot(d.exp1.manipulation, aes(fill=name, xdist=dist_normal(mean, sd))) +
  stat_slab(normalize="groups", data= ~ filter(., name=="Normal")) +
  stat_slab(normalize='groups', data= ~ filter(., name=='Abnormal'), alpha=0) +
  xlab("Focal Cause") +
  scale_fill_manual(name="Normality",
                    labels=c("Normal<br>(\u03C3=50)",
                             "Abnormal<br>(\u03C3=1)"),
                    values=PALETTE) +
  theme_cc() +
  theme(axis.line.y=element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y=element_blank(),
        axis.text.y=element_blank(),
        axis.title.y=element_blank(),
        legend.text=element_markdown())

p.exp1.manipulation2 <- ggplot(d.exp1.manipulation,
                               aes(fill=name, xdist=dist_normal(sum_mean, sum_sd))) +
  stat_slab(normalize="groups", data= ~ filter(., name=="Normal")) +
  stat_slab(normalize='groups', data= ~ filter(., name=='Abnormal'), alpha=0) +
  xlab("Focal Cause + Alternate Cause") +
  scale_fill_manual(name="Normality",
                    labels=c("Normal<br>(\u03C3=50)",
                             "Abnormal<br>(\u03C3=1)"),
                    values=PALETTE) +
  theme_cc() +
  theme(axis.line.y=element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y=element_blank(),
        axis.text.y=element_blank(),
        axis.title.y=element_blank(),
        legend.text=element_markdown())

((p.exp1.manipulation1 / hide_plot(p.exp1.manipulation2)) &
   coord_cartesian(xlim=c(0, 300), expand=FALSE)) +
  plot_layout(guides="collect")
```

# Experiment 2 {.dark}

## Manipulations
:::{.r-stack .r-stretch}
::::{.fragment}
```{r}
#| label: exp2-manipulation-1
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6
d.exp2.manipulation <- tibble(name=c('Abnormal','Normal'),
                              mean=c(25, 75), sd=c(50, 50),
                              actual=floor(75 + 25/3 + 2/3),
                              sum_mean=c(100, 150), sum_sd=sqrt(2*50^2)) |>
  mutate(name=factor(name, levels=c('Normal', 'Abnormal')))

p.exp2.manipulation1 <- ggplot(d.exp2.manipulation,
                               aes(fill=name, xdist=dist_normal(mean, sd))) +
  stat_slab(normalize='groups', data= ~ filter(., name=='Normal')) +
  xlab('Focal Cause') +
  scale_fill_manual(name='Normality',
                    breaks=c('Normal', 'Abnormal'), drop=FALSE,
                    labels=c('Normal<br>(\u03BC=50)',
                             'Abnormal<br>(\u03BC=1)'),
                    values=PALETTE) +
  theme_cc() +
  theme(axis.line.y=element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y=element_blank(),
        axis.text.y=element_blank(),
        axis.title.y=element_blank(),
        legend.text=element_markdown())

p.exp2.manipulation2 <- ggplot(d.exp2.manipulation,
                               aes(fill=name, xdist=dist_normal(sum_mean, sum_sd))) +
  stat_slab(normalize='groups', data= ~ filter(., name=='Normal')) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept=2*actual)) +
  xlab('Focal Cause + Alternate Cause') +
  scale_fill_manual(name='Normality',
                    breaks=c('Normal', 'Abnormal'), drop=FALSE,
                    labels=c('Normal<br>(\u03BC=50)',
                             'Abnormal<br>(\u03BC=1)'),
                    values=PALETTE) +
  theme_cc() +
  theme(axis.line.y=element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y=element_blank(),
        axis.text.y=element_blank(),
        axis.title.y=element_blank(),
        legend.text=element_markdown())

((p.exp2.manipulation1 / hide_plot(p.exp2.manipulation2)) &
   coord_cartesian(xlim=c(0, 300), expand=FALSE)) +
  plot_layout(guides='collect')
```

# Conclusions {.dark}

## Conclusions

:::{.incremental}
* Actual causation is well-studied when events are binary
* But we don't know much about cases where causes are continuous variables!
* Even when participants learn relevant norms, they don't affect causal judgments in such contexts
:::
